name: sentfromai
description: Email for AI agents. Gives your agent its own inbox: create inboxes, send, reply in-thread, forward, search, manage drafts, domains, webhooks and allow/block rules. 21 annotated tools over SentFromAI's hosted MCP server, plus an email-etiquette skill.

SENTFROMAI_API_KEY.title: SentFromAI API key
SENTFROMAI_API_KEY.description: Use your saved sf_live_ API key. With no key, first follow https://docs.sentfrom.ai/agent-install.md to bootstrap through REST when enabled, or create a key in the console. MCP needs this key; human claim enables sending without changing it. Sent as a Bearer token.
